title: Standard Cleaning
shortDescription: Recurring upkeep for clean, comfortable everyday spaces.
overview: Best for homes and apartments that need consistent maintenance rather than a full reset.
includedItems: Kitchen counters, sink, appliance exteriors, and surfaces.
Bathrooms, mirrors, fixtures, tubs, showers, and toilets.
Dusting reachable surfaces and high-touch areas.
Vacuuming, sweeping, mopping, and trash removal.
Bed making and light room straightening on request.

title: Deep Cleaning
shortDescription: A detailed reset for buildup, neglected zones, and seasonal refreshes.
overview: Deep cleaning is ideal before recurring service, after busy seasons, or when a home needs extra attention.
includedItems: Everything in standard cleaning.
Baseboards, cabinet fronts, door frames, switches, and handles.
Detailed bathroom descaling and kitchen degreasing.
Extra attention to corners, edges, fixtures, and buildup.
Optional inside oven, fridge, windows, and laundry add-ons.

title: Move-In and Move-Out Cleaning
overview: Support for empty homes, apartments, rental turnovers, leases, listings, and final walkthroughs.
includedItems: Kitchen, bathroom, room, closet, and floor cleaning.
Cabinet interiors when empty and accessible.
Baseboards, switches, doors, fixtures, and vents.
Inside oven and fridge available as add-ons.
Rental turnover and property manager coordination on request.

title: Office Cleaning
shortDescription: Reliable cleaning for focused, professional workplaces.
overview: Office cleaning plans for small businesses, studios, clinics, and shared workspaces.
includedItems: Reception areas, desks, conference rooms, and common spaces.

Trash removal, vacuuming, sweeping, and mopping.

title: Carpet Cleaning
shortDescription: Refresh high-traffic carpeted areas as part of your cleaning plan.
overview: Add carpet cleaning to residential, move-out, or office appointments for a more complete reset.

Vacuuming and refresh guidance.

question: How does pricing work?
answer: Pricing is based on the service type, size of the property, number of rooms, current condition, cleaning frequency, and any add-ons.

question: Are quotes final?
answer: Online quotes are starting estimates. We confirm the final scope and price after reviewing your details and any special conditions.

question: How does booking work?
answer: Submit a quote or appointment request, then our team confirms availability, access instructions, arrival window, and service scope.

question: How does payment work?
answer: Payment details are confirmed before service. Commercial and recurring clients may qualify for invoice-based billing.

question: Can I cancel or reschedule?
answer: Yes. Contact us as early as possible. Late cancellations may be subject to a fee depending on the appointment type.

question: What is included in deep cleaning?
answer: Deep cleaning includes standard cleaning tasks plus more detailed attention to buildup, baseboards, fixtures, cabinet fronts, detail dusting, and hard-to-reach areas.

question: What is included in standard cleaning?
answer: Standard cleaning covers routine maintenance: kitchens, bathrooms, dusting, floors, trash, counters, sinks, mirrors, and high-touch surfaces.

question: Do you offer recurring cleaning?
answer: Yes. Weekly, biweekly, and monthly service plans are available for homes and workplaces.

question: What should I expect from before and after results?
answer: Results depend on the condition of the space, surface age, stains, and buildup. We set expectations before work begins.

question: Do you bring supplies and equipment?
answer: Yes. We can bring professional supplies and equipment. We can also use your preferred products if requested in advance.

question: What areas do you cover?
answer: We serve Austin, TX and nearby areas including Round Rock, Cedar Park, Pflugerville, Lakeway, Bee Cave, Georgetown, and Leander.
